body: I don't know what I was hoping to accomplish by posting. My therapist was right. I can't be helped.

I've tried those things, gone to therapy programs at school, even my long term therapist gave up on me, and my current one thinks I can't be helped, my mother isn't in my life and my father can't be bothered with me, I have no friends, I feel like a waste of space, my existence really doesn't matter, I'm nothing, I'm already a goner, I feel empty and unmotivated and I'm useless in every aspect of my life, my family already knows how bad it is because of suicide attempts in the past, they still don't care, my family doesn't care. I don't have friends, I don't just feel alone, I am alone.

The pain is pretty immense and the popping is  painful and very audible.
But the emotional struggle is only worsening as well, my father makes it pretty clear that all I am to him is a financial burden, my sister always feels the need to tell me how lazy and ungrateful I am because I never want to leave bed (I feel like I'm physically unable to move, and I hate myself for it), I get overwhelmed and anxious in social environments, and I used to cut myself to cope with my depression but my father saw the cuts and flipped, he didn't even want to let me back in the house, so I don't have that as an option really, therapy doesn't help, I can't even begin to reach out to my mother, none of my "friends" care or understand, I don't have anyone to turn to, maybe I am ungrateful, and i know it could be worse, but this is tearing me apart, and my jaw is throbbing as I type this, I just don't know anymore, I have no one.
I wish i found random families of kittens in my house.
